title: Royal Scratch Match
description: Imported v0.5 standalone call-and-response rhythm game for 2–10 contestant slots. One local touch/keyboard player is supported by default, remaining slots can be bot-controlled, and additional human slots can receive inputs through the existing JavaScript API. Room-code phone multiplayer is not yet integrated.
